mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_organization WHERE agreement_status = 'PENDING'

WITH station_daily_usage AS ( SELECT u.stat_date, u.station_code, SUM(u.usage_count) AS usage_count FROM t_station_usage_stat u WHERE u.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.stat_date, u.station_code ) SELECT d.stat_date, NVL(s.district_name, '미분류') AS region_name, SUM(d.usage_count) AS usage_count FROM station_daily_usage d JOIN t_station s ON s.station_code = d.station_code GROUP BY d.stat_date, NVL(s.district_name, '미분류') ORDER BY d.stat_date ASC, region_name ASC

WITH current_station_usage AS ( SELECT u.station_code, SUM(u.usage_count) AS current_usage FROM t_station_usage_stat u WHERE u.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.station_code ), previous_station_usage AS ( SELECT u.station_code, SUM(u.usage_count) AS previous_usage FROM t_station_usage_stat u WHERE u.stat_date BETWEEN #{previousFrom} AND #{previousTo} GROUP BY u.station_code ), priority_candidates AS ( SELECT c.station_code, s.station_name, c.current_usage, NVL(p.previous_usage, 0) AS previous_usage, CASE WHEN NVL(p.previous_usage, 0) = 0 AND c.current_usage > 0 THEN 100 WHEN NVL(p.previous_usage, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((c.current_usage - p.previous_usage) / p.previous_usage) * 100, 1) END AS usage_growth_rate FROM current_station_usage c JOIN t_station s ON s.station_code = c.station_code LEFT JOIN previous_station_usage p ON p.station_code = c.station_code WHERE c.current_usage >= 10 AND ( NVL(p.previous_usage, 0) = 0 OR c.current_usage >= p.previous_usage * 1.1 ) ) SELECT rank, station_name, usage_growth_rate, review_status, total_count FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY current_usage DESC, station_name ASC) AS rank, station_name, usage_growth_rate, CASE WHEN usage_growth_rate >= 20 THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'MONITOR' END AS review_status, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count FROM priority_candidates ) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY rank ASC

SELECT organization_name, contact_name AS manager_name, CAST(submitted_at AS DATE) AS requested_date, agreement_status AS status, address AS area_name FROM t_organization WHERE agreement_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
